words: Altogether I've 7450 US cents to spend - that's the whole lot. Here's my list - 3 x denim jackets where the neckline is polo collar; 1 x area rugs where the pile height is 1 inch; 2 x formal where the strap material is alloy and the feature is calendar or water resistant. Each thing on the list should be there ready for me - none missing. Get the total down as far as it'll go. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. So anyway – the polo collar is the one thing I've settled on – everything else about this denim jacket is a tangle of weeds in my head. I've two small lads and a mad week – school run at eight – football in the rain on Saturday – then my own mam's seventieth in the hotel on Sunday – so the jacket will be out in front of all sorts of people. I've been standing in the hall in front of the mirror for a month now in the same tired old fleece – wondering what sort of person I'd like to be walking through the door when I'm wearing something new – and honestly I can't decide. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. I've scrolled through so many of them that they've all blurred together like a bed of groundsel – so I'd sooner you asked me the one thing that would sort the wheat from the chaff before you show me a hundred of them – and I'll answer you straight away.
